title: Figure 6: Object Sightings by Certain and Doubtful Evaluations, All Years and Each Year
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart with six panels (Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloons, Insuf. info., Unknown, Other). Each panel has bars for "All years" and 1947–1952, with the horizontal axis running from 30 percent "Certain" on the left to 30 percent "Doubtful" on the right. Caption: "FIGURE 6 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY CERTAIN AND DOUBTFUL EVALUATIONS FOR ALL YEARS AND EACH YEAR"; drawing A-7484, page 22.
